cases.name: Laura Christine Boren Thomas
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative: He fatally stabbed her, cut open her chest and pulled out a portion of her lung, thinking he was actually removing her heart. He went to the bedroom shared by their 4-year-old son and Boren's 13-month-old daughter, fatally stabbed both children and cut their hearts out of their chests. Her father Paul Boren found her spread eagle on the white carpet, smeared with blood, a gaping hole in her chest. Beside her left leg, a one-dollar bill was folded length-wise, the radiating eye of the pyramid facing up.

cases.name: Elizabeth "Clarice" Harrison
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Her love of music was inspired by her grandfather Willie Jacobs, a talent in his own right.  She was a student of voice under Jill Brown for 12 years, and sang at several venues over the years, becoming a regular at the Wylie Opry. A lifelong resident of Sherman, she graduated from Sherman High School in 2012.  In 2020, she graduated from Austin College with a Bachelor of Arts degree in music.  She was employed at Quickverse Convenience Store in Sherman where she was being trained to become a manager."
cases.narrative:
On 8/4/2022, her body was found close to Tom’s residence, near Bethany Rd. and FM 1417 in Sherman, TX. His blood and saliva were found at the scene.

He confessed to detectives that he sexually assaulted Harrison and then murdered her to prevent her from telling law enforcement. She left her job to visit his home and never returned, and her husband found her car behind his house. She had gone to check on Tom, who was described as a family friend, because his grandmother had recently passed away.
